title: SystemOneAdvert (entry of the `systemone` array in POST /v1/node/register)
description: One System One decision-model placement a node serves. Members are snake_case although the enclosing register body is camelCase (specs/47_NODE_JOIN_AND_HARDWARE_REGISTRATION.md section 2.2; recorded inconsistency, not endorsed). slots is the schedulable unit; max_concurrency is the admission bound and, when present, MUST be >= slots, which JSON Schema draft-07 cannot express (semantic rule; the conformance vectors carry it). Absent device and max_concurrency are omitted, never null.
